meta.title: Toolchain
meta.description: Adds a Toolchain page to Settings between Models and Plugins. Installed npm/pip dependencies are listed with a Delete button per row above a one-tap install grid, and all 13 dependency-root folders show their sizes. Toolchains are laid out name + version: a missing one installs in one tap through apt or npm (make, gcc, git, cargo, rustc, golang-go, default-jdk-headless, python3-pip, pnpm), owned ones can be deleted, and OS-provided ones are marked System to protect the running Harness.
